SELECT T1.Street, T1.City, T1.State, T1.Zip
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 30
ORDER BY CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.EdOpsName, T2.County, T2.District, T2.School, T1.`Academic Year`
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.EdOpsCode = '31'
AND T2.County = 'State'
AND T2.District = 'State Special Schools'
AND T2.School = 'Fremont'
AND T1.`Academic Year` BETWEEN 2014 AND 2015
ORDER BY T2.`Academic Year` DESC

SELECT T1.type, T1.name
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.mcmId
WHERE T2.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
AND T2.type IN (
  SELECT T2.type 
  FROM cards AS T3
  INNER JOIN sets AS T4 ON T3.uuid = T4.mcmId
  WHERE T4.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
)

SELECT T1.manaCost 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.layout = 'normal' AND T1.frameVersion = 2003 AND T1.borderColor = 'black' AND T1.availability = 'mtgo,paper'

SELECT T1.type, T1.subtypes, T1.supertypes
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T2.language = 'German'

SELECT T1.type, SUM(T3.cost) 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.cardKingdomId 
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.cardKingdomId 
WHERE T1.type = 'Card' 
AND T3.cost > (SELECT MAX(T4.cost) FROM cards AS T4 
               INNER JOIN budget AS T5 ON T4.id = T5.cardKingdomId 
               INNER JOIN expense AS T6 ON T5.id = T6.cardKingdomId 
               WHERE T4.type = 'Card')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id)
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*')
AND T2.text LIKE '%triggered ability%'
AND T1 ConvertedManaCost > 5
AND T2.language = 'Italian'

SELECT T1.name, T1.originalType, T1.originalText, T1.originalType IN ('Summon - Angel', 'Angel of Mercy') 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.code 
WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' 
AND T1.originalType IN ('Summon - Angel', 'Angel of Mercy')

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM sets AS T1 
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code 
WHERE T2.language = 'Italian' AND T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T2.translation IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T2.format = 'premodern' AND T2.status = 'Legal' 
AND T1.side IS NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1

SELECT T2.language
FROM sets AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2
ON T1.code = T2.setCode
WHERE T1.block = 'Ravnica' AND T1.baseSetSize = 180

SELECT T1.name
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.originalType = 'Creature' AND T1.colors = 'B' AND T2.language = 'French'

SELECT T2.OwnerUserId, T1.DisplayName
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2
ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010'
AND T2.FavoriteCount = (
  SELECT MAX(FavoriteCount)
  FROM posts AS T3
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T3.CreationDate) = '2010'
)

SELECT T1.DisplayName 
FROM posts AS T1 
INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId 
WHERE T1.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation'

SELECT T2.Title, T1.DisplayName, T1.FavoriteCount
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2
ON T1.Id = T2.OwnerUserId
INNER JOIN comments AS T3
ON T2.Id = T3.PostId
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2014'
AND T3.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0'
ORDER BY T1.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.TagName 
FROM tags AS T1 
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.ExcerptPostId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R' AND T1.Count = 0

SELECT T1.Score
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT T2.DisplayName, T1.Title, T2.Reputation
  FROM posts AS T1
  INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
) AS T3
ON T1.Title LIKE '%Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing%'

SELECT T1.ViewCount 
FROM posts AS T1 
INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId 
WHERE T1.Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT T2.Body 
FROM posts AS T1 
INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId 
WHERE T2.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Id = 6347
SELECT T1.Text FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Score = 17

SELECT T2.DisplayName, T1.Title
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts'

SELECT 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) 
FROM 
  customers AS T1 
  INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
  WHERE 
    T1.Currency = 'CZK' 
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312 
    AND T2.Consumption = ( SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth ) 
    AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.Date = T2.Date WHERE T2.Date = '201306'

SELECT 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) 
FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'
AND T2.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Amount - T2.Price, 0)) AS More_SME
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'EUR'
AND T2.Price > T2.Amount

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) = '2013/07/12'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE player_api_id IN (
  SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE birthday BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'
)

SELECT t1.name 
FROM League AS t1 
INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id 
WHERE t2.season = '2010/2011' 
AND t1.name = 'Poland' 
AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t2.home_team_goal > t2.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id) > 0

SELECT t1.player_name
FROM Player AS t1
JOIN (
  SELECT player_api_id, AVG(heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE height > 180
  GROUP BY player_api_id
) AS t2
ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
ORDER BY t2.avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT t2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass 
FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 
INNER JOIN Team AS t2 
ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id 
WHERE t2.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' 
AND t1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass IN ('Slow', 'Balanced', 'Fast')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.player_name)
FROM Player_Attributes AS t1
INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t2.preferred_foot = 'left'
AND t2.attacking_work_rate = 'low'
AND t1.defensive_work_rate = 'high'
SELECT t1.team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND t1.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT t1.player_name, t2.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS t2
INNER JOIN Player AS t1
ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.`date`) = '2011'
AND t2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT T1.id
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.birthday LIKE '%1970%' AND T2.birthday LIKE '%October%'

SELECT 
  A2 AS district, 
  A3 AS state, 
  A14 / A13 * 100 AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM 
  district AS A1 INNER JOIN loan AS A2 ON A2.account_id = A1.account_id INNER JOIN client AS A3 ON A3.client_id = A2.client_id WHERE A3.gender = 'M' AND A3.status = 'D' AND A2.amount < 100000

SELECT T3.account_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 = ( SELECT MAX(T2.A11) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id ) ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.frequency, T1.amount, T1.date
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T1.duration > 12
AND T1.date BETWEEN '1993-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(account_id) 
FROM loan 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', date) = '1997' 
AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE district_id = 1)

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage,
  COUNT(*) AS total_amount
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000
GROUP BY SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) 
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN T2.driverId END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverId) 
FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
WHERE T1.date BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2009-12-31' 
AND T1.name LIKE 'Japanese%'

SELECT T1.name 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T2 
ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId 
WHERE T2.position = 1 
AND T2.milliseconds = (
  SELECT MIN(milliseconds) 
  FROM lapTimes 
  WHERE position = 1 
  AND time = (
    SELECT MIN(time) 
    FROM lapTimes 
    WHERE position = 1 
  )
)

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, T2.points
FROM drivers AS T1
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T2.wins = ( SELECT MAX(COUNT(wins)) FROM driverStandings )
ORDER BY T2.points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng
FROM circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitID = T2.circuitID
WHERE T2.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'
AND T1.name = 'Sepang International Circuit'

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId 
WHERE T2.raceId = 872 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY T1.dob DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId 
WHERE T2.raceId = 592 AND T2.time IS NOT NULL 
ORDER BY T1.dob DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name, T2.points
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverId = T3.driverId
WHERE T3.forename = 'Lewis' AND T3.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY T1.year ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng
FROM circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId
WHERE T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'
AND T1.country = 'Malaysia'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.lat, T1.lng 
FROM circuits AS T1 
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId 
WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL
AND T2.rank = 1
AND T1.year = 2007
AND T2.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T3.dob DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T1.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND T2.rank = 1 AND T1.year = 2007

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.phone, T2.expense_description
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member
WHERE T1.cost > ( SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1
                 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
                 INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member )

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.link_to_event IN (
  SELECT event_id
  FROM event
  GROUP BY event_id
  HAVING COUNT(event_id) > 10
)
AND T1.position = 'Member'
AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT T1.last_name, T2.department, T2.college 
FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code 
WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois' 
AND T1.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT T1.type, T2.cost
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker'
AND T2.cost = 0

SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T2.cost
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
WHERE T2.zip = (SELECT zip_code.zip_code FROM zip_code AS T3 WHERE T3.type = 'Standard' AND T3.city = 'Holtsville' AND T3.county = 'Suffolk County' AND T3.state = 'New York')
SELECT DISTINCT T2.city FROM zip_code AS T1 INNER JOIN county AS T2 ON T1.county = T2.county WHERE T1.state = 'Virginia'

SELECT T1.event_name, T3.cost
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget
WHERE T2.event_status = 'Open'
ORDER BY T3.cost ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.colour = 'Blue' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM superhero AS T1 
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id 
INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id 
WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' 
AND T1.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT T1.superhero_name, T1.height_cm, T1.weight_kg, T1.attribute_value
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'durability'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name
SELECT T2.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T1.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'
SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
SELECT T1.height_cm FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE gender = 'Female'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5
AND T1.SEX = 'M'
AND T2.CPK >= 250
AND T2.Birthday BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'

SELECT 
  T1.Diagnosis,
  COUNT(T1.ID) AS num_patients
FROM 
  Patient AS T1
  INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE 
  T2.IGM NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 400
GROUP BY 
  T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY 
  num_patients DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(T1.Birthday))), 70) < 70

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1
AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Description) = '1997'
AND T1.SEX = 'F'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
SELECT T2.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS Age, 
       T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' 
AND T2.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory AS T3 
               WHERE T3.Diagnosis = T1.Diagnosis 
               AND T3.`Examination Date` >= T1.`Examination Date`)

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age 
FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T2.HGB >= 10 AND T2.HGB < 17 
ORDER BY T2.`First Date` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX , STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.UN BETWEEN 29 AND 30

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) 
FROM atom AS T1 
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element, T2.label 
FROM atom AS T1 
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 
ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id 
WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR060'

SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1  INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery

SELECT 
    T1.element,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'h' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM 
    atom AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE 
    T2.label = '+' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7 AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '4'
GROUP BY 
    T1.element

SELECT T1.molecule_id, T2.label
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = ' = '
AND T2.label = '+'
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.atom_id BETWEEN SUBSTR('21', 7, 2) AND SUBSTR('25', 7, 2) AND T2.label = '+' ORDER BY T2.molecule_id

SELECT T1.bond_type, T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
SELECT COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR%_19'
